u0: Initial state: the agent has not yet picked up the matching key. Progress: nothing acquired and the door is still locked. Next objective: locate and pick up the key matching the door's color in the starting room; acquiring it satisfies has_door_key and advances to u1.
u1: The agent is holding the matching door key, and the door is not open yet (or was relocked). Progress: key possession is secured. Next objective: move to the locked door and toggle it open with the key in hand; opening it satisfies door_open and advances to u2. Do not drop the key before the door is open, since that would lose key possession without opening the door.
u2: The door has been opened after acquiring the key; the obligation to open the door whenever holding the key is satisfied for this phase. Progress: access to the box room is available. Next objective: release the key if still carried (safe now that the door is open), enter the second room, and pick up the mission's designated box; doing so satisfies target_picked_up and advances to the terminal state u3.
u3: Terminal success state: the mission's target box has been picked up after the key acquisition and door-opening requirements were met. Progress: the full chain (hold key, open door, pick up target box) is complete. No further objective; the episode ends here.
